item.tib: bder gshegs rig 'dzin dgongs pa 'dus pa 'chi med gsang ba sum dril gyi rgyud las bdud rtsi sman gyi byang bu 'od dkar snang ba
item.coloph: ces pa 'di nyid sprul pa'i gter chen nyid kyis bka' yi bskul ma mdzad pa bzhin/ gsang sems rgyud 'dzin yongs kyi tha shal ba g.yungadrung bstan pa 'brug grags bsod nams dpal bzang pos bgyis pas thams cad 'chi med rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
